Hexagon EAM

Industry-leading enterprise asset management software.

Founded 1986
Pricing Model Enterprise
Deployment Cloud / SaaS, On-Premise, Hybrid

Overview

Formerly Infor EAM, Hexagon EAM is a highly configurable and scalable solution designed to extend asset lifecycles and improve productivity. It offers specialized industry editions and advanced features like transit asset management, fleet management, and predictive maintenance.
